QuestInfo.name: The Call of Athena
QuestInfo.0: The Oda clan seems to be forming an alliance with the Black Wings. Athena Pierce will want to know.
QuestInfo.1: Maple World will be in grave danger if the Oda clan are allowed to ally with the Black Wings. Get back to Henesys and tell Athena Pierce right away.
QuestInfo.2: Athena Pierce has vowed to gather reinforcements from around Maple World to fight this potential alliance between the Black Wings and the Oda Clan. She seems to be a powerful figurehead here.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 7,682\nCan proceed to the quest The Vast Unknown

0.0: Akechi Mitsuhide wants help from the Black Wings? Nobunaga's ambitions have grown. He must seek to control both Sokoku and this new land.
0.1: Nobunaga must be curbed like the rabid dog he is. I must return to the green-eyed archer and tell her of the danger she is in.
